Methods exist check objects single canonical plot (one object class maps one figure). Object types can plotted several different ways — aniframe, feeds plot_trajectory() plot_timeseries() — deliberately single method, since nothing dispatch choose shapes. as_plot_data.check_confidence() turns per-keypoint density grid closed violin polygons: keypoint sits integer y position, density mirrored either side along confidence (x) axis (width-normalised every violin maximum width). Grid points clip x peak dropped, thin tails bimodal-bridging necks disappear split distribution becomes separate polygons. keypoint x-axis category; identity varies (e.g. individual) collapses group factor faceting. x positions, per-keypoint median / quartile overlay, facet ride along attributes. Returns frame classed anivis_check_na_gapsize_data. as_plot_data.check_na_timing() reconstructs, compact gap table, missing / present frame counts per time interval — one row per (group, interval, status). single interval width (frames) chosen groups (Sturges' rule default) bars line across panels, gap's overlap interval counted, per-frame data needed. value share (measure = "percent") count ("count"), width interval's span time units, frame interval size rides along attribute. Returns frame classed anivis_check_na_timing_data. as_plot_data.check_segment_length() turns per-track density grid relative lengths closed violin polygons, check_confidence(): segment sits integer y position, structure's first segment top, density mirrored either side along relative-length (x) axis cut clip x peak. segment always y axis; key varies (individual, session) collapses group factor faceting. track never measured nothing draw left . y positions, per-track overlay median quartiles (capped check's clamp, like grid) share , tolerance x positions guides, clamp whether track exceeded (clamped), facet ride along attributes. Returns frame classed anivis_check_segment_length_data.

title: Draw point events as dots or raster ticks — geom_event_point
text: "point" (default) — dot event time. "raster" — short vertical tick event time, classic spike-raster look (standard e.g. neuron spike trains). input type column (e.g. anicore::anievent()), rows type != "point" dropped — point half state/point pair complementing geom_event_state(). default mapping aes(x = start) — every aesthetic caller. text: ggplot2 layer.

title: Draw state events as horizontal bars — geom_event_state
text: default mapping aes(xmin = start, xmax = stop) — every aesthetic caller. Common patterns: aes(fill = label) — colour bout's interior behaviour. aes(colour = label) — outline bout (keeps sub-pixel-wide bouts visible zoom). aes(y = label) (y = channel, y = subject, ...) — spread bouts across rows. y mapping bouts collapse onto single line. + ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ channel, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) — split channels panels. Opinionated wrappers (themes, colour scales, sensible defaults) intended live one layer ; geom deliberately bare. thin wrapper around ggplot2::GeomRect: subclass adds setup_data step derives ymin / ymax y + height, discrete y scale keeps label rows ranked correctly (including per-panel scales = "free_y").
